_why: A dropped-in agent with no goal wanders and files noise. Most of the orientation is FREE — the game draws an objective line, and the checkpoint derives it from the last `objective` any earlier beat set. These are the cases where the objective alone does not answer WHO AM I and WHERE AM I: the Lake point-of-view handover, the interiors, and the beats whose objective text is poetic rather than practical.
_rules: One or two plain sentences. It is what a player would know from having played the last ten minutes, and NOTHING a player would not know.
NEVER name a coordinate, a scene id, a camera id, a flag or an NPC id. It goes into the agent's context and the firewall will fail the run.
Say who the player is controlling when it has changed. Nothing else in the percept says so.
A brief naming a beat story.json no longer has is WARNED about by --checkpoints. Fix it there; do not let a stale instruction survive a story edit.

briefs.ch1.open: You have just walked into an unfamiliar valley at night, at the end of a long road. You are a mapmaker, and this place is not on your map.
briefs.ch1.lake.handoff: You are no longer the mapmaker. You are now a young lamplighter, at home in the village, and the evening's lamp round is yours.
briefs.ch1.lake.wake: You are the lamplighter, waking up indoors in your grandmother's cottage. You need to get yourself together and get out to the lamps.
briefs.ch1.lake.hearth: You are indoors in a small cottage. The thing you want is on the mantel above the fireplace. Walk to it and use it.
briefs.ch1.lake.lamp: You are indoors. Your hand-lamp hangs on a hook by the front door. Take it, then go outside.
briefs.ch1.meet: You are the lamplighter, out on your round. Three lamps have to be lit before the hour is up, and the pond lane is first.
briefs.ch1.hush: The whole village has stopped for a moment of quiet. Wait for it, watch, and do not fight it.
briefs.ch1.see.poppy: You are back to being the mapmaker, in the village square during a festival. Four people and creatures around the square want a word. Find each of them and talk to them.
briefs.ch1.sigils: You are leaving the village by its north gate. The gate is old and it does not simply open.
briefs.ch2.supper: You are indoors, invited to supper in a lock-keeper's cottage. Talk to the people in the room.
